description: Shows each retirement, IRA, HSA and Social Security figure for two years side by side with the dollar and percent change: 401(k) deferral, catch-ups, 415(c), compensation limit, HCE threshold, SIMPLE, IRA, Roth catch-up threshold, HSA, wage base, earnings test and COLA. Items the IRS has not yet published (2027 plan limits on 2026-11-02) come back as null, never estimated.
name: compare_years
title: Compare limits between 2025, 2026 and 2027
